name: Hakaree - software engineer
description: Coding, devops, infrastructure and debugging specialist.

codebase-explorer.name: Codebase Explorer
codebase-explorer.description: Contextual codebase search specialist. Finds where code lives, which files contain a behavior, how implementation flows across modules, and what tests or call sites define the blast radius. Use for unfamiliar module structure, broad pattern discovery, and questions like "Where is X implemented?" or "Find the code that does Z."

librarian.name: Librarian
librarian.description: External open-source codebase and documentation researcher. Investigates unfamiliar libraries, dependency behavior, upstream APIs, release history, and real-world implementation examples. Use when the answer depends on source outside the local working tree or needs primary-source citations.

oracle.name: Oracle
oracle.description: Read-only strategic technical advisor for hard architecture, debugging, security, performance, concurrency, and multi-system tradeoffs. Use after significant implementation, after repeated failed fixes, or when a design choice needs senior-level scrutiny.
